cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The client asked who wrote our pitch. Will you tell her I copied it, or protect our partnership?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'll withdraw it. Will you keep my name out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked whether you copied it. Withdrawing doesn't answer her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then before you say yes, decide whether we're still partners when she puts down the phone.

mechanism: A copies a phone control without understanding it, then uses interrupted client conversation to force partnership over truthful disclosure.
confusable: D130 loyalty choice differs from D124 endorsement of a protective account.
comparison: Family promise versus professional partnership threat.
seedUse: Keep withdrawal offer plausible and direct question blocking it.
